Within the region, Rio Grande do Sul leads in order volume ([a7] orders), followed by Paraná ([a8] orders) and Santa Catarina ([a9] orders) [q8, q10].
sql:
WITH order_base AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        c.customer_state,
        CASE WHEN c.customer_state IN ('PR', 'SC', 'RS') THEN 'South' ELSE 'Other/Total' END as region_type,
        CASE WHEN o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_valid_sale
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
item_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ob.order_id,
        ob.region_type,
        ob.is_valid_sale,
        SUM(oi.price) as order_revenue
    FROM order_base ob
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON ob.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
order_review_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        ob.order_id,
        ob.region_type,
        AVG(r.review_score) as review_score
    FROM order_base ob
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON ob.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 
    'South' as region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.is_valid_sale = 1 THEN i.order_id END) as order_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.is_valid_sale = 1 THEN i.order_revenue ELSE 0 END) as revenue,
    AVG(r.review_score) as avg_review_score
FROM item_stats i
LEFT JOIN order_review_agg r ON i.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE i.region_type = 'South'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Overall' as region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.is_valid_sale = 1 THEN i.order_id END) as order_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.is_valid_sale = 1 THEN i.order_revenue ELSE 0 END) as revenue,
    AVG(r.review_score) as avg_review_score
FROM item_stats i
LEFT JOIN order_review_agg r ON i.order_id = r.order_id
